request.initial_prompt: Belarius. You, Polydore, have prov'd best woodman and Are master of the feast. Cadwal and I Will play the cook and servant; 'tis our match. The sweat of industry would dry and die But for the end it works to. Come, our stomachs Will make what's homely savoury; weariness Can snore upon the flint, when resty sloth Finds the down pillow hard. Now, peace be here, Poor house, that keep'st thyself!

You polador have proved best woodmen and are master of the feast.
Cadwell and I will play the cook and servant.
The sweat of industry would dry and die, but for the end it works too.
Come, our stomachs will make what's homely savory.
Weariness can snore upon the flint, when resty sloth finds the down pillow hard.
Now, peace be here, poor house, that keeps thee thyself.
